title: AI ROI Calculator™
tagline: See the dollar return AI could generate for your business this year.
description: Enter a few numbers about your business and we'll estimate the yearly cost savings and revenue upside AI could realistically deliver — plus where to start.

categories.label: AI Leverage Potential
categories.recommendation: Start where ROI is instant: AI-drafted client communication and proposals. It costs almost nothing and pays back the same week.

categories.label: Implementation Readiness
categories.recommendation: Assign one owner and one hour per week to AI implementation. ROI comes from consistent rollout, not tools.

questions.text: What is your approximate annual revenue?
questions.help: A rough number is fine — this stays on your device until you choose to share it.

questions.text: How many people work in the business (including you)?
What is your average hourly labour cost per person?
questions.help: Salary + overhead divided by hours. Many service businesses land between $30 and $80.

questions.text: How many hours per week does each person spend on repetitive tasks?
questions.help: Emails, data entry, scheduling, reporting, copy-paste work. Industry average is 8–12.

questions.text: How much of your client work follows a repeatable pattern?

options.label: Almost none — every job is unique

questions.text: Do you currently lose leads or sales due to slow follow-up?
Is there someone in your business who could own an AI rollout (even part-time)?

options.label: Yes — we have a clear owner

questions.text: How quickly does your business usually adopt new tools?

options.label: Reasonably fast when value is clear
Fast — we like to be early

metrics.label: Team hours on repetitive work per year
metrics.description: Total hours across your whole team spent on automatable work.

metrics.label: Potential yearly labour savings
metrics.description: Assumes AI and automation recover a conservative 50% of repetitive time.

metrics.label: Potential yearly revenue upside
metrics.description: A conservative 4% revenue lift from faster lead response, better follow-up and more selling time.

metrics.label: Total estimated annual AI opportunity
metrics.description: Combined savings and upside — before tool costs, which are typically under $200/month.

bands.label: High Opportunity, Low Readiness
bands.summary: Your numbers above show a real dollar opportunity — but slow follow-up and stretched capacity are blocking it. The play: start tiny, prove ROI in weeks, and let the wins fund the rollout.
actionPlan: Week 1: Pick ONE high-cost repetitive task from this assessment as your pilot.
Week 1: Set a simple success metric (hours saved or response time).
Week 2: Implement the smallest possible AI fix for it (template, auto-reply, AI draft).
Week 2: Fix lead follow-up first if you're losing sales to slowness — that ROI is immediate.
Week 3: Measure the pilot honestly. Keep what works, kill what doesn't.
Week 3: Share the win with your team to build buy-in.
Week 4: Choose your next 2 automations based on the numbers above.
Week 4: Book an AI Audit to build an ROI-ranked rollout plan.

bands.label: Strong ROI Case
bands.summary: The math is on your side: your business has repeatable work, real labour costs and the capacity to adopt. The calculated opportunity above is achievable within 6–12 months with a steady rollout.
actionPlan: Week 1: Rank your repetitive tasks by (hours × hourly cost) — biggest number first.
Week 1: Assign an AI rollout owner with one protected hour per week.
Week 2: Automate lead response and follow-up end-to-end.
Week 2: Roll out AI drafting for email and proposals to the whole team.
Week 3: Automate one internal workflow (reporting, scheduling or invoicing).
Week 3: Create a shared prompt library so results are consistent.
Week 4: Compare hours saved vs the estimate above and adjust.
Week 4: Book an AI Audit to accelerate the remaining opportunity.

bands.label: Ready to Capture
bands.summary: You're primed: repeatable work, adoption appetite and ownership in place. The opportunity above is yours to capture — the only risk is moving too slowly while competitors catch up.
actionPlan: Week 1: Commit to a 90-day AI rollout with the dollar target calculated above.
Week 1: Kick off with the highest-cost workflow first.
Week 2: Deploy AI across client communication, proposals and content.
Week 2: Automate every hand-off between your core tools.
Week 3: Pilot an AI assistant on your own business data (FAQs, docs, pricing).
Week 3: Track savings weekly on a visible scorecard.
Week 4: Reinvest saved hours into sales capacity — that's where ROI compounds.
Week 4: Book an AI Audit to validate the plan and add advanced plays.
